notes.title: Cards and Towers is officially joining forces with indie.io!
notes.content:
We’re incredibly excited to announce that Cards and Towers has partnered with indie.io to help bring our game to even more players around the world! 🎉

As a small indie studio made up of a father and his children, this partnership is a huge step forward for us. It allows us to focus on what we love—designing and developing fun, challenging, and unique gameplay—while the incredible team at indie.io supports us behind the scenes with marketing, community support, and event representation.

[previewyoutube=D7tr6NWu0fM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]About Cards and Towers[/h3]

Cards and Towers is a dynamic mix of card game mechanics, tower defense strategy, and roguelike replayability. Craft your own deck, defend your base tower, and survive waves of enemies in an endlessly replayable experience. Whether you’re combining cards to level up or deploying towers and units strategically, each run is a fresh challenge.

We started developing Cards and Towers because we’re passionate about games that encourage creative thinking and strategic planning. Our goal is to create a game that’s not only fun to play but also rewarding every time you pick it up. Working as a family, we’ve poured our hearts into every pixel and playtest—and we’re thrilled to finally share it with the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44992252/ea3faf0e2030d161ea846d2453168606b07d3e7f.png[/img]

[h3]Why indie.io?[/h3]

Choosing to partner with indie.io was a natural decision for us. As a small team, we needed a publishing partner who truly understands the indie spirit and has a proven track record of helping indie games reach more players. The feedback we heard from other developers who have worked with them was overwhelmingly positive, and we immediately felt like our project was in great hands.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44992252/4758c940a3417fa911314553cde96f6a1c0c6939.png[/img]

For those of you who may not know, working with a game publishing platform like indie.io greatly helps indie developers focus on game development while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic. From managing our store page to crafting smart marketing campaigns and supporting our game at both digital and live events, indie.io has already made a huge difference.

[h3]What’s Next?[/h3]

We’ve got some exciting updates coming up, and this partnership is just the beginning. We can’t wait to share more news, features, and surprises with you as we move forward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44992252/c4741c69dc634877da97babb103ecc0a3d96aaa8.png[/img]

👉 Don’t forget to follow and wishlist Cards and Towers on Steam, and join our Discord community to be the first to hear about future updates and announcements!

Follow us on our socials, join the discussion, and get ready to defend your tower like never before!

Family Devs.
